requirement: Define an order Status enum whose value lookup ignores case and surrounding whitespace and accepts legacy spellings through _missing_, raising ValueError for anything else, mark shipped and cancelled as final, and advance statuses only along an allowed transition table.
skeleton: _LEGACY spelling map, a unique Status Enum with a _missing_ classmethod normalizing strings and an is_final property, a TRANSITIONS table of frozensets, and advance converting the target with Status() and checking the table.
caption: Order statuses with the standard-library enum module. Status is an Enum decorated with unique, with values pending, paid, shipped and cancelled. Its _missing_ classmethod, which Enum calls only when a value lookup fails, returns None for non-strings, strips and lower-cases strings, maps legacy spellings canceled and sent through _LEGACY, and returns the member with that value or None, so Status(value) raises ValueError saying the value is not a valid Status for anything unknown. The is_final property is True for SHIPPED and CANCELLED. TRANSITIONS maps each status to a frozenset of allowed next statuses: pending to paid or cancelled, paid to shipped or cancelled, and nothing after shipped or cancelled. advance(current, target) converts target with Status(target), which also accepts a Status member unchanged, and raises ValueError saying cannot move from the current value to the new value when the move is not in the table. The fixture asserts that padded upper-case PAID and pending resolve, that canceled and Sent resolve to CANCELLED and SHIPPED, that lost, 3, None and an empty string raise ValueError, that exactly SHIPPED and CANCELLED are final, four allowed moves including a legacy spelling and a member argument, and that shipped to cancelled and pending to shipped raise ValueError.

plan.intent: Parse and move order statuses safely
constraints: Value lookup ignores case and surrounding whitespace
Legacy spellings canceled and sent are accepted
Shipped and cancelled are the final states
Only moves in the transition table are allowed, others raise ValueError

rationale.teaches: Enum._missing_ as the hook for lenient value lookup that still fails loudly, and a transition table keyed by members.
rationale.why: Looking up by name or defaulting unknown values looks fine for canonical inputs and only breaks on legacy data, padded strings or typos coming from outside.

ops.docstring: Order statuses as an Enum that accepts legacy spellings and checks moves.

candidates.why_wrong: Surrounding whitespace is kept, so a padded value such as PAID with spaces is rejected.
Legacy spellings such as canceled and sent are no longer translated and raise ValueError.
A cancelled order is not treated as final, so the set of final states is incomplete.
Looking members up by name ignores values, legacy spellings and Status arguments, raising KeyError.
Unknown strings silently become PENDING instead of raising ValueError.
